description: This file contains functions for resetting a device to factory defaults, including handling special files, shutting down services, and deleting configuration files and directories.

methods.name: resetToFactory
methods.description: Resets the device to factory defaults and reboots.

methods.name: resetForRebranding
methods.description: Resets the device for rebranding, removing specific files, then reboots.

methods.name: doReset
methods.description: Performs the reset process, optionally killing processes and deleting files.

methods.name: isReservedFilename
methods.description: Checks if a filename is in the reserved list that should not be deleted.

methods.name: recurseDir
methods.description: Recursively traverses directories, adding non-reserved files and directories to a list for deletion.
